meta.label: DSS Project Maintenance
meta.description: Macros to maintain DSS projects: clear the data of datasets selected by their tags, or of all datasets, report the tags of datasets. Macros that change data simulate by default.
meta.author: François CABANNES

params.label: Downloaded recaps
params.description: A recap downloaded from DSS and opened on its own loads AG Grid Community to show its interactive table. Without it, the recap shows a plain table.

params.name: ag_grid_url
params.label: AG Grid URL
params.description: AG Grid Community 29.2.0 by default. Set the URL of an internal mirror, or leave empty so that no recap loads it.

params.name: ag_grid_integrity
params.label: AG Grid integrity hash
params.description: The hash of that file, such as sha256-.... Change it with the URL. Empty: not checked.

params.label: Tag lists
params.description: The "Cat. Tags" lists of the macro forms offer the category tags of the datasets of the project.

params.name: listed_tag_categories
params.label: Tag categories
params.description: Only the tags of these categories are listed, such as Stage. Empty: all categories.
